name: Wiki.js
description: A beautiful wiki for notes and documentation.
compose:
services:
  wikijs:
    image: ghcr.io/requarks/wiki:2
    container_name: wikijs
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:3000"
    environment:
      DB_TYPE: "sqlite"
      DB_FILEPATH: "/wiki/data/db.sqlite"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/data:/wiki/data
